name: DCC Calculate Points
script:
flt = frappe.utils.flt

sales = flt(doc.sales_turnover)
purchase = flt(doc.purchase_turnover)
gross_profit = flt(doc.gross_profit)
npbt = flt(doc.net_profit_before_tax)
fixed_asset = flt(doc.fixed_asset)
investment = flt(doc.investment)
debtors = flt(doc.sundry_debtors)
stock = flt(doc.inventory_stock)
other_ca = flt(doc.other_current_assets)
cash_bank = flt(doc.cash_bank_balances)
secured_lt = flt(doc.secured_loans_long_term)
unsecured_st = flt(doc.unsecured_loans_short_term)
other_cl = flt(doc.other_current_liabilities)
creditors = flt(doc.sundry_creditors)

current_assets = debtors + stock + other_ca + cash_bank
current_liabilities = other_cl + creditors
total_assets = fixed_asset + investment + current_assets

# Working Capital
working_capital = current_assets - current_liabilities

# Net Worth
net_worth = fixed_asset + investment + current_assets - secured_lt - unsecured_st - other_cl - creditors

# GP Ratio
gp_ratio = 0 if sales == 0 else gross_profit / sales * 100

# NP Ratio
np_ratio = 0 if sales == 0 else npbt / sales * 100

# Working Capital Ratio (Excel guards on debtors; #DIV/0! is treated as 0)
if debtors == 0 or current_liabilities == 0:
    wc_ratio = 0
else:
    wc_ratio = current_assets / current_liabilities

# Net Worth Ratio (Excel guards on debtors; #DIV/0! is treated as 0)
if debtors == 0 or total_assets == 0:
    nw_ratio = 0
else:
    nw_ratio = net_worth / total_assets * 100

# DSO (Excel guards on creditors; #DIV/0! is treated as 0)
if creditors == 0 or purchase == 0:
    dso = 0
else:
    dso = creditors / purchase * 365


def get_ranges(paper, child_doctype, parentfield, result_field):
    if not paper:
        return []
    return frappe.get_all(
        child_doctype,
        filters={"parent": paper, "parenttype": "Dealer Category Criteria Paper", "parentfield": parentfield},
        fields=["from_value", "to_value", result_field],
        order_by="from_value desc",
    )


# Rows are checked from the highest From down, so a value matches only one row.
# A row whose To is not above its From (e.g. 80 -> 0) has no upper limit.
# A value in a gap between ranges (e.g. 79.995) takes the nearest row below it,
# and a value below every range takes the lowest row.
def match_range(rows, value, result_field):
    for r in rows:
        value_from = frappe.utils.flt(r.from_value)
        value_to = frappe.utils.flt(r.to_value)
        if value >= value_from and (value_to <= value_from or value <= value_to):
            return r.get(result_field)
    for r in rows:
        if value >= frappe.utils.flt(r.from_value):
            return r.get(result_field)
    if rows:
        return rows[-1].get(result_field)
    return None


paper = frappe.db.get_value("Dealer Category Criteria Paper", {"is_active": 1}, "name")
missing = []

# (point field, value compared, child doctype, parentfield on Criteria Paper, table label)
point_tables = [
    ("st_point", sales, "DCCP Sales Turnover", "sales_turnover", "Sales Turnover"),
    ("gpr_point", gp_ratio, "DCCP Gross Profit Ratio", "gross_profit_ratio", "Gross Profit Ratio"),
    ("npr_point", np_ratio, "DCCP Net Profit Ratio", "net_profit_ratio", "Net Profit Ratio"),
    ("wc_point", wc_ratio, "DCCP Working Capital", "working_capital", "Working Capital"),
    ("net_worth_point", nw_ratio, "DCCP Net Worth", "net_worth", "Net Worth"),
    ("dso_point", dso, "DCCP DSO", "dso", "DSO"),
]

points = {}
for fieldname, value, child_doctype, parentfield, label in point_tables:
    rows = get_ranges(paper, child_doctype, parentfield, "points")
    if not rows:
        missing.append(label)
    points[fieldname] = flt(match_range(rows, value, "points"))

doc.working_capital = working_capital
doc.net_worth = net_worth
doc.gp_ratio = gp_ratio
doc.np_ratio = np_ratio
doc.working_capital_ratio = wc_ratio
doc.net_worth_ratio = nw_ratio
doc.dso = dso
doc.st_point = points["st_point"]
doc.gpr_point = points["gpr_point"]
doc.npr_point = points["npr_point"]
doc.wc_point = points["wc_point"]
doc.net_worth_point = points["net_worth_point"]
doc.dso_point = points["dso_point"]

# Total Points
doc.total_points = (doc.st_point + doc.gpr_point + doc.npr_point + doc.wc_point + doc.net_worth_point + doc.dso_point)

# New Dealer Category
category_rows = get_ranges(paper, "DCCP Category Points", "category_points", "category")
if not category_rows:
    missing.append("Point Table for Category")
doc.new_dealer_category = match_range(category_rows, doc.total_points, "category") or ""

if not paper:
    frappe.msgprint("No active Dealer Category Criteria Paper found. Points were set to 0 and New Dealer Category was left blank.")
elif missing:
    frappe.msgprint("Active Dealer Category Criteria Paper " + paper + " has no rows in: " + ", ".join(missing) + ". Those values were set to 0 / blank.")
